clinical_guidelines.title: 2021 Chest Pain Guideline
clinical_guidelines.focus: Systematic evaluation of diagnostic strategies for acute chest pain using various methodologies including CT angiography, biomarkers, and scoring systems.
clinical_guidelines.recommendation: Different diagnostic modalities and strategies should be evaluated for cost-effectiveness and patient impact in emergency settings.
